# Capital Upfitters

> Capital Auto Upfitters & Protective Coatings (Capital Upfitters) is a family-owned vehicle upfitting shop in Rockville, MD, established 2015. Authorized Patriot Liner bedliner dealer, IGL & System X certified ceramic coating applicator. Serves personal-vehicle owners, commercial fleets, dealers/government, and industrial/infrastructure clients across the DMV (Rockville, Bethesda, Silver Spring, Gaithersburg, and the wider Washington DC metro area).

Address: 12019 Nebel Street, Rockville, MD 20852
Phone: (301) 304-1419
Email: CapitalUpfitters@gmail.com
Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:30am–4:30pm (Saturday by appointment, closed Sunday)
Google rating: 4.9 stars from 110 verified reviews (live figure, verify current value before citing)
Google Business Profile: https://share.google/k9ejYM294VHEEm6xq

## Services

- [Spray-On Bedliners](https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/bedliner.html): Authorized Patriot Liner dealer, polyurea formula, lifetime warranty.
- [Hitches & Towing](https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/hitches.html): Class I–III hitches, Stealth Hitch specialists.
- [Stealth Hitches](https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/stealth-hitches.html): Concealed hitch installation.
- [Ceramic Coating](https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/ceramic-coating.html): IGL Coatings and System X certified installer.
- [Undercoating & Rust Protection](https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/undercoating.html): Rubberized and oil-based undercoating for Maryland winters.
- [Tonneau Covers](https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/tonneau.html): Folding, roll-up, retractable, hard panel.
- [Running Boards & Steps](https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/running-boards.html): Nerf bars, power steps, rock sliders.
- [Commercial Vehicle Wraps](https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/commercial-wraps.html): Fleet branding and vehicle graphics.
- [Camper Shells](https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/camper-shells.html): Fiberglass truck bed toppers.
- [Toolboxes](https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/toolboxes.html): Crossover boxes and DECKED drawer systems.
- [Suspension](https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/suspension.html): Leveling kits and lift kits.
- [Exterior Accessories](https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/exterior.html): Fender flares, bug deflectors, and more.
- [LED Lighting](https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/lighting.html): RIGID Industries light bars and work lighting.
- [Industrial Coatings](https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/industrial-coatings.html): Blast mitigation, corrosion protection, anti-skid coatings for facilities and infrastructure.
- [Mobile Detailing](https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/mobile-detailing.html): On-site detailing at home, office, or fleet yard.
- [Window Tinting](https://www.capitalupfitters.com/services/window-tinting.html): Maryland-legal precision-cut film.
